gist.summary: Added @zeros372’s Image-Captioning- to the image app catalog and README recent-apps list. Its listing describes an Arabic, right-to-left static web app with a client-side Pollinations.ai OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow in a single index.html file, without a backend. RankNest rotated out of the README recent-apps list; this change does not remove it from the catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli hovers beside a framed picture and its caption card, wearing tiny reading glasses; a lime green (#ecf874) screen glows among flowers and code-plants against warm cream, mint, and peach gradients. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, subtle CRT glow, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
